name: Game
report: The exploit stemmed from a logic error in newBidEtherMin(), enabling a single attacker to place bids exceeding 5% of the last bid amount without validation. This flaw resulted in unintended addresses receiving the full last bid amount. Additionally, using 'call' in _sendEther facilitated re-entrancy attacks, allowing the attacker to make unauthorized transfers.
report_zh: 漏洞源于newBidEtherMin()中的逻辑错误，使单个攻击者能够出价超过上一个出价金额的5%且未经验证。该缺陷导致非预期地址收到了全部上一个出价金额。此外，在_sendEther中使用'call'促进了重入攻击，使攻击者能够进行未经授权的转账。
